label_license: CC-BY-4.0; photographs retain each source license
limits: Not a representative Chinese OCR benchmark: deliberately small educational corpus.
Upstream NVIDIA zh_hant bucket includes Simplified/mixed text; literal text is never converted.
Public model pretraining may have seen public photographs; contamination unknown.
62 retained Commons train crops; whole/crop tasks are multi-scale supervision, not independent source images.

All heldout photos/questions and all 85 candidate Commons train crops received independent actual visual AI-agent peer review. NVIDIA actual visual review covered 67 candidate crops, not all retained synthetic examples.
All NVIDIA crops filtered against nonselected official line quads at intersection >1 square pixel. Unannotated words in background photographs cannot be detected by this geometry filter.

Original full-photo target bboxes are retained as acquisition provenance; natural question locations determine the task where diagnostic bboxes clipped glyphs. Rejected crop artifacts are excluded from reconstruction manifest.

peer_review.review_status: Independent AI-agent visual peer review; no independent human gold claimed.
